nodes.label: Internet / Threat Zone
nodes.role: External threat actors and internet traffic. Primary source of APTs, ransomware campaigns, DDoS, and phishing. All inbound traffic originates here before hitting the perimeter.

nodes.label: WAF / Next-Gen Firewall
nodes.role: Layer 7 Web Application Firewall combined with a Next-Gen Firewall. Inspects all inbound/outbound traffic, blocks SQLi, XSS, and protocol anomalies in real time. DPI + IPS/IDS inline.

nodes.label: DMZ / Perimeter Zone
nodes.role: Demilitarized zone hosting public-facing services: reverse proxies, load balancers, and API gateways. Isolated from internal segments by strict ACLs and stateful inspection.

nodes.label: Identity Provider / MFA
nodes.role: Zero Trust identity broker. Enforces MFA, device posture checks, and conditional access policies. Issues short-lived tokens. Every access request is verified regardless of network location.

nodes.label: SIEM / SOC Platform
nodes.role: Central SIEM aggregates logs, events, and NetFlow from all nodes. Correlation rules fire on anomalies and trigger SOC analyst workflows, automated playbooks, and SOAR integrations.

nodes.label: EDR / Endpoint Detection
nodes.role: EDR agents on all workstations and servers. Detects fileless malware, memory injection, lateral movement, and privilege escalation. Provides process telemetry to SIEM in real time.

nodes.label: Internal Network
nodes.role: Micro-segmented internal network zones — Finance, Engineering, HR, OT. East-west traffic controlled by Zero Trust policy engine. No implicit trust between segments.

nodes.label: Threat Intel Feed
nodes.role: Real-time threat intelligence ingestion from MISP, VirusTotal, STIX/TAXII feeds. IOC matching enriches SIEM alerts. Automatically updates WAF blocklists and EDR signatures.

nodes.label: Zero Trust Policy Engine
nodes.role: Policy Decision Point enforcing least-privilege access across all segments. Every request is evaluated: user identity + device posture + context. Never trust, always verify.

nodes.label: Cloud Workloads / CSPM
nodes.role: Cloud Security Posture Management continuously monitors AWS, Azure, and GCP configurations. Detects misconfigured S3 buckets, overly permissive IAM roles, and unencrypted data stores.
